research.notes: Registry lookups (ProPublica, IRS) were unavailable (rate limited), so nonprofit status, EIN and exact legal name are unconfirmed. epicenternow.org names the operator as 'The Institute for Excellence in Education' (a subsidiary of NCSI); the agenda says 'The Institute for Excellence'. The About page lists info@charterinstitute.org while the Contact page lists info@nationalcharterschools.org; the Contact page address was used. Oakland was not mentioned on any page.

profile.address: 711 West Pickard Street, Suite M, Mount Pleasant, Michigan 48858
profile.summary: The National Charter Schools Institute provides training, consulting and support to people and organizations in the charter school community, including authorizers, school boards and school operators. Its signature programs include Epicenter, an online workspace that helps charter authorizers, schools and management organizations manage documents, deadlines and decisions.

review.notes: The agenda's dba National Charter Schools Institute in Mt. Pleasant, MI matches the cited site (711 W Pickard St, Mount Pleasant), and Epicenter is a charter-authorizer workspace that fits a Charter Schools Office technology services agreement; epicenternow.org names the operator as The Institute for Excellence in Education, a subsidiary or affiliate of NCSI. The summary, website, phone, email (as shown on the Contact page), address and headquarters are all supported and neutral.
